verdict.rationale: Sift documents a comprehensive REST API surface (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows) with public developer docs, and a live probe confirms the Events API endpoint is reachable and responds per documented spec. Machine-oriented docs (llms.txt) further support programmatic/agentic discovery. missing for 10: no evidence of official SDKs beyond mobile/JS being AI-agent friendly, no independent third-party API-quality review, and no explicit mention of API design tailored for autonomous agent use.
